name: Muttaburrasaurus
isnote: Recovered in Rhabdodontomorpha by Dieudonné et al. 2016, but more recent research suggests a more basal position among ornithopods (English Wikipedia revision cited); placed directly in Ornithopoda.
sum: A large herbivorous ornithopod of north-eastern Australia from the Albian to Cenomanian, with a bulge on the snout.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: QM F6140, from the Mackunda Formation of Queensland.
material: Teeth found near Hughenden and at Lightning Ridge, and an opalised scapula that may belong to it.
biology: A herbivorous ornithopod; the sources consulted give no more.
author: Bartholomai and Molnar 1981
